message.reasoning_content:
Let me compute. a.txt: 17, -4, 23, 8 → sum = 44.

b.txt words: pear, apple, pear, plum, Apple, apple, fig, plum → unique: pear, apple, plum, Apple, fig → 5 unique. Sorted case-sensitively (ASCII, uppercase first): Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum.

Let me do this with real commands.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "mkdir -p out
# 1. sum of integers
awk '{s+=$1} END{printf "%d\n", s}' data/a.txt > out/sum.txt
# 2. unique words, case-sensitive lexicographic sort
tr -s ' \t\n' '\n' < data/b.txt | grep -v '^$' | sort -u > out/words.txt
# 3. notes
S=$(cat out/sum.txt); W=$(wc -l < out/words.txt)
printf 'sum=%s; unique_words=%s\n' "$S" "$W" > out/notes.txt
echo "=== sum.txt ==="; cat out/sum.txt
echo "=== words.txt ==="; cat out/words.txt
echo "=== notes.txt ==="; cat out/notes.txt"}
